content:
jun: quick heads-up — running hybrid AWQ+GPTQ int8 profile on the prod-sim dataprep. seeing newline collapse inside CSV cell fields for table-extract task. example below, reproduced with the same prompt.
rachel: can you paste the raw output? is it happening before or after our csv serializer?
sam: putting my +1 — saw a similar visual collapse last week but assumed a frontend formatter issue.
jun: here's minimal reproducer and output.
```csv
id,text
1,"Hello\nWorld"
2,"Line1\nLine2, with comma"
```
Actual decoded output (broken):
```csv
id,text
1,"HelloWorld"
2,"Line1Line2, with comma"
```
jun: note the `\n` removed inside quoted fields; happens only on hybrid-awq-int8 profile, not on fp16 or pure gptq.
olivia: weird — could be our token stitching or the post-info serializer trimming control chars during detokenize. any stack traces/logs?
jun: log snippet from runner:
```
[2026-03-18 09:12:33] model:hybrid-awq-int8 | detokenize: replaced token 50256 with ''
[2026-03-18 09:12:33] serializer:csv | normalize_newlines=True
```
jun: run command I used: `./runtest --profile=hybrid-awq-int8 --task=tablex --seed=17 --output=out.csv`
rachel: Can you bisect between quant libs? maybe AWQ postprocess step changed. try gptq weights with awq runtime? also check `normalize_newlines` default.
sam: I kicked off a quick smoke with `--profile=awq-int8-only` and `--profile=gptq-only` on same seed. awq-only shows collapse, gptq-only preserved newlines.
olivia: assigning to @jun to attach bisect artifacts. add `--dump-tokens` so we can see token stream before detokenize.
jun: done, uploaded artifacts to s3: s3://redwood-ci/quant-bakeoffs/1749234567/ . dump-tokens shows token ids for the newline were present (10) then disappeared after postproc.
eng-ml-ci-bot: build #4892 finished — tests for serializer passed on fp16 and gptq-only, failed on hybrid-awq-int8 (1 failing test: csv_newline_preservation).
rachel: hypothesis: AWQ int8 runtime uses a custom detokenizer that strips control chars to reduce token count; could be aggressive sanitization.
sam: quick patch idea: add a flag to serializer to preserve control chars if they are inside quoted CSV fields. can we reproduce with unit test?
jun: I'll add unit test and bisect quant runtime next. planning to roll out a canary tweak to serializer and run overnight bakeoff. tagging @olivia for review.
olivia: ack. please include regression test and note in PR description: reproducer + s3 link + baseline results.
rachel: thanks. if anyone hits it during the day use `--profile=fp16` as workaround. :thumbsup:
